path_metadata.normalization: Public path strings are portable; original evidence files remain unchanged. Run IDs and original scientific/evidence checksums retain their original meanings.
path_metadata.retained_inputs: artifacts/ paths resolve from the submission root; Data/ paths refer to externally supplied datasets at the documented submission-root location.
path_metadata.historical_outputs: results/ paths inside execution_records are relative to the external original evidence archive, not retained local outputs or execution targets. Existing source_evidence, summary_source and figure source paths retain their declared historical provenance scope.
path_metadata.metadata_checksums: input_sha256 retains original frozen-file checksums. public_metadata_sha256 provides current byte checksums only for path-redacted public metadata. Original evidence, source, scientific input and dataset checksums are never substituted.
